# Restaurant Oost

> Indonesian family restaurant at Zijlweg 82 in Haarlem, the Netherlands. Dine in, takeaway (afhalen) and rijsttafel catering for groups of 10 or more.

Oost is run by Levy (kitchen) and Nijne (front of house), who cook the way their grandmothers Oma Fanny and Oma Norma taught them. The menu carries all five of Indonesia's national dishes (gado-gado, soto, saté, nasi goreng, rendang), and half of it is vegetarian. Every dish is marked vegetarian and/or spicy, sambal comes on the side, and everything on the menu can be taken away. The site is in Dutch, with an English version under /en.

## Visit

- Address: Zijlweg 82, 2013 DL Haarlem, 10 minutes' walk from Haarlem station
- Bus stop: Hoofmanstraat, almost at the door
- Parking: paid street parking nearby; bikes can go out front
- Hours: Mon 12:00–22:00, Tue closed, Wed–Fri 12:00–22:00, Sat–Sun 17:00–22:00
- Reservations: not required, but advised on Friday and Saturday; walk-ins welcome
- Solo diners: sit at the large shared table (stamtafel)
- Groups: welcome, call ahead to check space
- Payment: card (pin) or cash
- Children: welcome; saté, loempia or sharing the rijsttafel
- Allergies: tell staff when ordering; they know what is in every dish

## Menu

Prices in euros. (v) vegetarian, (spicy) marked pittig on the menu.

### Complete meals (Compleet samengesteld)

- Nasi Campur, €16.00: rice or bami, two meat/fish/chicken dishes, two vegetarian dishes and an egg
- Nasi Campur Speciaal, €19.50: rice or bami, three meat/chicken/fish dishes, two vegetarian dishes, an egg, a saté skewer and garnishes
- Rijsttafel OOST, €26.50 pp (from 2 people): meat, chicken, fish, vegetarian dishes, saté, rice, bami and garnishes to share
- Vegetarische Rijsttafel (v), €24.50 pp (from 2 people)
- Saté Combi, €17.50: saté ayam, domba and udang with house sauces
- Saté Maaltijd, €12.50: saté of choice with rice, a vegetarian dish and garnishes

All dishes below can also be ordered separately.

### Mains: meat, chicken and fish

- Daging Rendang: beef slow-cooked in coconut milk and spices
- Daging Empal: fried beef in an aromatic spice paste
- Ayam Ketjap: chicken thigh in sweet soy sauce with onion
- Ayam Rica-Rica (spicy): chicken thigh stewed in a fresh, hot spice mix
- Sambal Goreng Udang (spicy): black tiger prawns in a mildly hot red sauce with peteh beans
- Cumi Cumi Hitam: squid in a dark, heavily spiced sauce

### Vegetarian dishes

- Sambal Goreng Boontjes (v, spicy): green beans in sambal sauce
- Sayur Lodeh (v): vegetables in creamy coconut broth
- Tahoe Taotjo (v): fried tofu in fermented soybean sauce
- Tumis Kailan (v, spicy): stir-fried kailan with garlic and chilli
- Sambal Goreng Telor Peteh (v, spicy): boiled eggs in a hot red sauce with peteh beans
- Terong Balado (v, spicy): fried aubergine in tomato sambal

### Saté (3 skewers)

- Saté Ayam, €7.50: grilled chicken thigh with peanut sauce
- Saté Domba, €9.50: grilled lamb with shallot-ketjap sauce
- Saté Udang, €10.50: grilled prawns with garlic-coriander sauce

### Eggs

- Heet Eitje (spicy), €1.75: boiled egg in hot sauce
- Kerrie Eitje, €1.75: boiled egg in curry sauce

### Rice and bami

- Witte Rijst (v), €3.00
- Nasi Goreng (v), €6.50
- Bami Goreng (v), €6.50
- Nasi Kuning (v), €5.50: yellow coconut rice

### Snacks

- Lemper, €3.00: sticky rice filled with spiced coconut chicken
- Pasteitje, €3.00: pastry filled with vegetables and beef
- Loempia Semarang (v), €2.25: house-made vegetarian spring roll
- Perkedel Jagung, €3.50: corn fritter

### Soups

- Soto Ayam, €8.50: spiced chicken soup
- Soto Vega (v), €8.50

### Desserts

- Spekkoek met IJs, €7.50: Indonesian layer cake with ice cream
- Dadar Gulung, €8.50: pandan pancake with palm sugar and coconut, with ice cream
- Kokofogatto, €5.50: coconut ice cream with an espresso shot

## Takeaway

- Everything on the menu can be taken away, during opening hours
- Order by WhatsApp or phone (06-48979760); say what you want and when you'll come
- Order about 30 minutes ahead; a day ahead for a rijsttafel
- Takeaway rijsttafel: from 2 people, 8 dishes with white rice, kroepoek and atjar, packed separately; vegetarian version available
- Up to 10 people counts as a large takeaway order; above that it is catering
- No delivery yet
- Reusable containers; bringing your own is welcome

## Catering

- For 10+ people in Haarlem and surroundings: birthdays, borrels, weddings, office lunches
- Rijsttafel buffet: 8–12 dishes, delivered hot in serving trays with a label per dish, from €28.50 pp (vegetarian from €25.50)
- Lunchbox: nasi campur per person with four dishes, rice, egg, kroepoek and sambal, from €17.50 pp; available from 11:30
- Borrel: saté with peanut sauce and loempia with sambal, priced per piece
- Spekkoek: whole, or sliced and wrapped per piece
- Pickup from 10 people; delivery and set-up from 20 people
- Delivery area: Haarlem, Heemstede, Bloemendaal, Overveen, Aerdenhout, Zandvoort, Spaarndam, Hoofddorp, Velserbroek; further by arrangement
- Food only, in dishes or chafing dishes with serving spoons; plates and warmers at cost price
- Book a week ahead, two in summer and around holidays; guest numbers can change up to two days before
- A priced proposal within a day; pay afterwards by invoice
- Portion guide: everyone takes seconds; for a borrel, 3–4 saté skewers and 2 loempia per person, double if it replaces a meal
